sloka: अविचिन्त्य तु तां वेलां दारुणां पितृगौरवात् ।उपसृत्याग्रतस्तस्य चरणाधोमुखी स्थिता ।विलिखन्ती मुहुर्भूमिमङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण भामिनी ।। ७.९.१५ ॥
transliteration: avicintya tu tāṁ velāṁ dāruṇāṁ pitṛgauravāt ।upasṛtyāgratastasya caraṇādhomukhī sthitā ।vilikhantī muhurbhūmimaṅguṣṭhāgreṇa bhāminī ।। 7.9.15 ॥

translations.english: Disregarding that dreadful time, out of respect for her father, the beautiful maiden approached and stood before him, her face bowed towards his feet, repeatedly scratching the ground with the tip of her big toe.
